author: moqah
body: Hey. Its been 4 months since my ban and I believe that it's time I am unbanned. There was no solid evidence other then the fact I said he was on my account and even if there was, Mr. Shoe and I are no longer acquainted so it wouldn't ever happen.

title: kaylani's appeal

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello kkkaylani,

Unfortunately, you must wait another 2-4 months before making an appeal. You claimed that he was on your account, which is enough sufficient evidence. Also, please be aware that your account is your responsibility. Due to this, I will be denying your appeal.

I will be leaving this open for a senior staff member to review. Thank you for your appeal.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez
